info.name: Retrieve metadata and tags of a file

params.name: fileId
params.description: UUIDv4 of the target file in datalake

params.name: bucket
params.description: S3 bucket of the target file in datalake

params.name: fileKey
params.description: S3 key of the target file in datalake

params.name: version
params.description: Version of the target file in datalake

items.docs:
This endpoint returns metadata and tags of a target file in datalake. This endpoint require either `fileId` or `bucket`, `fileKey` and `version` to be provided in order to uniquely identify file.

Validations performed by this endpoint:

1. if parameter `fileId` is not provided, then `bucket, `fileKey` and `version` parameters must be provided
2. if parameters `bucket`, `fileKey` and `version` are not provided, parameter `fileId` must be provided

info.name: Add metadata and tags to a file

items.docs:
This endpoint appends tags to a target file in the datalake or modifies the value of a metadata key. This endpoint requires either `fileId` or `bucket`, `fileKey` and `version` to be provided in order to uniquely identify a file.

info.name: Update metadata and tags to a file

items.docs:
This endpoint replaces metadata and tags to a target file in the datalake. This endpoint require either `fileId` or `bucket`, `fileKey` and `version` to be provided in order to uniquely identify file.

Target file query is determined by field `originalFile`. Target file is queried in two ways:
1. by `fileId` (UUID of a file in datalake)
2. by `bucket`, `fileKey` and `version`
